semantic_changes: Adds the repeated-resynchronization case; the previously generated cases are unchanged apart from sharing the same execution.

scope.description: Seven cases in one execution over three real OmniPaxos instances in one process with MemoryStorage and a deterministic FIFO in-process network: the previously fixed resync, single, control, newterm, snap and the new repeated-resynchronization case, which repeats the two-follower reconnection three times and samples all three nodes after each round under REPEAT_BASELINE/REPEAT_ROUND1..3. Public API only.
assumptions: Entry type Value has Snapshot = NoSnapshot; ClusterConfig { configuration_id: 1, nodes: [1,2,3], flexible_quorum: None } with default ServerConfig (batch_size 1).
Each round repeats the same public calls: node 1 and node 2 call reconnected(3) and the FIFO queue is drained to quiet, so every round is an independent re-established-connection event.
Leadership stays with node 3 throughout; no tick() timers run.
excluded: Snapshots, trimming, compaction and batching are not exercised.
No crate or package test suite is executed; only the generated test file.

basis.prefix: Same prefix as the fixed experiments of this lineage (node 3 leads via try_become_leader, five entries appended and decided, a StopSign proposed with reconfigure() and decided), then REPEAT_BASELINE samples all three nodes. Three rounds follow; each round calls node1.reconnected(3) and node2.reconnected(3), drains the queue to quiet, and samples all three nodes as REPEAT_ROUND1, REPEAT_ROUND2 and REPEAT_ROUND3. Samples report accepted_idx, decided_idx, decided_eq_accepted, is_reconfigured, read(5), read(6) and read_decided_suffix(0).

comparisons.description: Baseline before any re-synchronization: every replica reports six indices of content and the StopSign as decided.
Baseline before any re-synchronization: the reconfiguration is reported as decided by every replica.
After the first re-synchronization of both followers each of them still reports six indices of content.
After the second re-synchronization each follower still reports six indices of content.
After the third re-synchronization each follower still reports six indices of content.
After the third re-synchronization a follower's decided log read from index 0 still has six elements.
After the third re-synchronization the leader still reports six decided indices.
After the third re-synchronization the leader's decided index is still covered by the entries it holds.

The snap case repeats the resync scenario (node 3 leads, five entries decided, StopSign decided, then node 1 and node 2 call reconnected(3)) and samples the same public endpoints under the SNAP_* event names.

ClusterConfig { configuration_id: 1, nodes: [1,2,3], flexible_quorum: None } and default ServerConfig (batch_size 1).
Leadership is obtained with try_become_leader() and all SequencePaxos messages are delivered in FIFO order without loss.
excluded: No crate or package test suite is executed; only the generated test file.
